 Residents displaced after Roanoke apartment complex fire 
 By WDBJ7 Staff Published : Oct. 25, 2026 at 4:42 AM EDT | Updated : 11 hours ago Share Add Us On Google Add as a preferred source on Google ROANOKE, Va. (WDBJ) - WDBJ7 crews captured Roanoke Fire-EMS working to put out an apartment fire at Countryside Estates on Tuckawana Circle NW in Roanoke Sunday morning. 
 Fire crews report they marked the fire as under control at 5:29 a.m. and about 30 residents were displaced. No cause has been determined and no injuries were reported.
 Roanoke Fire-EMS says crews were dispatched to the fire in the 2300 block of Tuckawana Circle NW at 3:45 a.m. With “heavy fire” coming from the roof of the complex, the fire was upgraded to a 2-alarm fire response, prompting dispatch of additional units. 
 This is a developing story. Stick with WDBJ7 on air and online, WDBJ7.com for the latest information.
